n-k-k7-02.title: Nzvimbo imwe yezvirongwa zvitatu
n-k-k7-02.goal: Shandura kuwanikwa kwevanhu vatatu kwakanyanya kunoreverwa chete kuita mamiriro chaiwo, ita nguva dzekusangana dzakati wandei dzinosangana nevese, uye uone kuti shanduko imwe inochinja sei sarudzo.
n-k-k7-02.material:
Vadzidzi vatatu vanoronga musangano mumwe wekudzidza vhiki rino. Musangano unotora maawa maviri.

민수: 이번 주에 스터디를 한 번 하면 어때요? 두 시간쯤 걸려요.
지연: 저는 월요일은 아르바이트가 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 4시부터 괜찮아요.
민수: 저는 수요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요.
수진: 저는 금요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 9시까지는 모임이 끝나야 해요.

(Nguva dzese dziri p.m. kunze kwekunge nguva yataura. '6시 이후' inosanganisira 6 o'clock, uye '9시까지 끝나야 해요' inobvumira musangano kupera pa 9 chaipo.)
n-k-k7-02.thinking.2: Kuwana mhinduro dzinopfuura imwe nekufanotaura shanduko
n-k-k7-02.prereq.0: Unoziva mazita emazuva evhiki nenguva dzewachi
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.prompt: 민수 anoreva chii ne '화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요'?
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga izwi rinopatsanura Chipiri kubva kune mamwe mazuva, wobva wabvunza kuti rinobvisa chii paChipiri.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.1: Taura mutsara nemazwi ako kaviri: kamwe kuChipiri uye kamwe kune mamwe mazuva.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.a: Anogona kusangana paChipiri chete, kwete mamwe mazuva.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.a: '말고는' inosiyanisa Chipiri nemamwe mazuva; haiti Chipiri ndiro zuva rega.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.b: Anogona kusangana nezuva rimwe nerimwe mushure me6, asi neChipiri kwete pamberi pe6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.b: Dai Chipiri raiva rakafanana nemamwe mazuva, pakanga pasina chikonzero chekuritaura zvakasiyana.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.c: NeChipiri haana muganhu wakadaro; pamamwe mazuva ndimushure me6 chete.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.d: Makirasi ake anopera pa6 zuva rega rega, kusanganisira Chipiri.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.d: Saka '화요일 말고는' haaizonzwisisika; Chipiri ndiro rakasiyana.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.explain: 'A 말고는 B' zvinoreva 'kunze kwe A, B'. Pazuva rega rega kunze kweChipiri muganhu wemushure me6 unoshanda; Chipiri ndiro rakasiyana. (Chitatu rakabviswa nemutsara wake wekare.)
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nguva 3 dzakasiyana dzekusangana dzinokodzera vose. d = nhamba yezuva revhiki (1 = Muvhuro ... 5 = Chishanu), h = nguva yekutanga muawa dzakazara pawachi ye24-hour (semuenzaniso 16 zvinoreva 4 p.m.). Musangano unotora maawa maviri.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bvisa mazuva asina anouya kutanga, wobva wasarudza nguva yekutanga yekutanga neyekupedzisira pazuva rimwe nerimwe rakasara.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nguva yekupera ndiyo nguva yekutanga pamwe nemaawa maviri; itarise nemuganhu wa수진 pakupedzisira.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c0: Nhamba yezuva revhiki kubva ku1 kusvika ku5 neawa rakazara.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Shandisa nhamba yakazara yezuva revhiki kubva ku1 kusvika ku5 neawa rakazara rekutanga.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 지연 ane basa repakati nepakati neMuvhuro.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 지연 asununguka kubva ku4 p.m. chete.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Kunze kweChipiri, 민수 anogona kusangana mushure me6 p.m. chete.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Musangano unotora maawa maviri uye unofanira kupera kusvika ku9 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.explain: Chipiri neChina chete ndizvo zvasara mushure memiganhu mitatu yezuva. NeChipiri kutanga kupi nokupi kubva ku4 p.m. kusvika ku7 p.m. kunoshanda; neChina kutanga kunofanira kuva pa6 kana 7 p.m. (kupera kunofanira kuva kusvika ku9).
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe YENGUVA dzako uye uikurudzire muhurukuro yeboka muchiKorea (-요 ine mutsa): taura zuva revhiki nenguva yekutanga.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tora mutsara mumwe kubva pamusoro wotaura zuva renguva yawo muchiKorea.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wedzera chiperero chemubvunzo sa -어때요? kana chikumbiro chakajeka ne -해요.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Zuva nenguva zvandakanyora zvinoenderana nenguva imwe yandakavaka here?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakatarisa kuti hapana muganhu wemunhu wakatyorwa here?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.2: Inotaura zuva rakabviswa kuritsvaga chete; izvi zvakanaka.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.prompt: Zvino 수진 anochinja pfungwa: '금요일도 괜찮아요. 대신 8시까지는 끝나야 해요.' Vamwe vaviri havachinji. Nguva dzinogoneka dzinoitwa sei?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dzokorora mamiriro nemutemo mutsva: nguva yekutanga yekupedzisira ndeipi zvino kana musangano uchifanira kupera kusvika ku8?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa Chishanu nemunhu mumwe nemumwe, wobva waenzanisa marondedzero eChipiri neChina nedzekare.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.a: Chishanu pa6 p.m. chinovhura, uye kutanga kwekupedzisira neChipiri neChina kunodzikira.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.b: Hapana chitsva chinovhura, nokuti 민수 achiri kusagona neChishanu.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.c: Chishanu chinovhura kubva ku4 p.m., sezvakaita Chipiri.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.c: Chishanu hachisi Chipiri: 민수 anogona kusangana neChishanu mushure me6 p.m. chete.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.d: Chishanu chinovhura, uye nguva dzeChina dzinoramba dzakangoita sezvakanga zviri.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.d: Nguva yekupera yekare inocheka kutanga kwekupedzisira zuva rega rega, kusanganisira China.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.explain: Mutemo mutsva ndeuyu: pera pa8 p.m., saka kutanga kunosvika pa6 p.m. zvakawanda. Chishanu zvino chinoda kutanga pa6 p.m. chaizvo (민수 anoda 6 kana shure, 수진 zvino anoda 6 kana nekukurumidza). Chipiri chinoshaya 7 p.m. uye China chinochengeta 6 p.m. chete.

n-k-k7-01.title: Kutumira kwemahara, kune ani?
n-k-k7-01.goal: Edza zvinotaurwa nevatengi vakati wandei neziviso yekutumira, tsvaga zvinotaurwa zvisingatsigirwi neziviso, uye yambira shamwari kuti itarise chii.
n-k-k7-01.material:
Shamwari iri kutenga paInternet uye inokuratidza ziviso yekutumira yechitoro. Vatengi vakati wandei vataura kuti vanofunga kuti inoreva chii.

[배송 안내]
1. 구매 금액이 30,000원 이상이면 배송비는 무료입니다. 단, 쿠폰으로 할인을 받으신 경우에는 할인된 금액을 기준으로 합니다.
2. 제주도와 섬 지역은 배송비 3,000원이 추가됩니다.
3. 오후 2시 이전에 결제하시면 당일에 출고됩니다.
n-k-k7-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga ziviso pfupi ine nhamba ne 원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Vatengi vana mumwe nemumwe akatenga chinhu chimwe. Mutengi upi zvirokwazvo haabhadharire mari yekutumira zvachose?
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: Usaenzanise mutengo wepamusoro ne 30,000 pakarepo. Pfuura mutsara wese une nhamba muziviso uye utarise chero chinhu chinochinja huwandu hunoenzaniswa kana kuwedzera mari.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutengi mumwe nemumwe, verenga huwandu hunoverengwa, wobva wanyora chimwe chese chiri muziviso chingashanda kumutengi iyeye.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.a: 소라 (Seoul): mutengo wepamusoro 33,000원, akashandisa coupon ye 5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.a: Coupon inoderedza huwandu hunoverengwa. 33,000 - 5,000 = 28,000, iri pasi pe 30,000.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.b: 준호 (Jeju Island): mutengo wepamusoro 40,000원, pasina coupon
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: Huwandu hwake hwakakwana, asi ziviso inowedzera mari yakasiyana yedunhu rake, saka achiri kubhadhara chimwe chinhu.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.c: 민지 (Seoul): mutengo wepamusoro 36,000원, akashandisa coupon ye 5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: 29,000 iri pasi pe 30,000 uye hapana mamiriro anochinja izvozvo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 민지 anobhadhara 36,000 - 5,000 = 31,000원, iri 30,000 kana kupfuura, uye Seoul haina mari yekuwedzera. Huwandu hwa소라 shure kwecoupon ndi 28,000. 준호 anowana kutumira kwekutanga kwemahara asi ziviso inowedzera 3,000원 yeJeju. 태민 ari pasi pemuganhu.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Vatengi vanotaura nezvavakatenga. Sarudza mutsara mumwe une chirevo CHISINGATSIGIRWI neziviso (pangava nemitsara yakawanda yakadaro; chero mumwe unoverengwa).
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: Pamutsara mumwe nemumwe, verenga zvakare huwandu hunoshandiswa nechitoro, wobva watarisa nguva kana dunhu kana mutsara uchitaura.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa mazwi enhamba muziviso: ndeapi anoisa muganhu, uye rutivi rupi rwemuganhu runobvumirwa?
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Mitsara 2 ne 4 haitsigirwi. Mutsara 2: 32,000 - 4,000 = 28,000, iri pasi pemuganhu. Mutsara 4: kutumira kwezuva rimwe chete kunoda kubhadhara pamberi pe 2 p.m. Mutsara 1 wakanaka (31,000, pasina coupon), mutsara 3 unoenderana nemari yeJeju, uye mutsara 5 uri 30,000 chaizvo, inoverengwa se '이상'.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari muna 제주도 inokubvunza: '3만 원 넘게 사면 무료배송이지?' Pindura mumitsara 1-2 yechiKorea (-요 ine rukudzo inokwana; mazwi mashoma echiRungu anobvumirwa) uye uiudze zvinhu zviviri zviri muziviso zvaanofanira kutarisa asati atarisira kutumira kwemahara.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga zvakare mutsara wese une nhamba weziviso uye ubvunze kuti upi ungachinja zvinobhadharwa neshamwari yako.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mhinduro yemubvunzo wake kutanga, wobva wawedzera mamiriro maviri ne 그런데 kana 그리고.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura zvinhu zvose zviviri: dunhu rake nechikamu chakadzikiswa here?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yangu inogadzirisa pfungwa yake panzvimbo yekungodzokorora mutemo here?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.2: Sezvo uchigara muna 제주도, pane 3,000원 yekuwedzera, uye kana ukashandisa 쿠폰 mutengo wakadzikiswa ndowunoverengwa.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Mhinduro yakasanganiswa nechiRungu ichipfuura zvekutarisa zvepamusoro.

n-k-k7-03.title: Ongororo inosvika kupi?
n-k-k7-03.topic: Kuyera ongororo ine zvikamu zvakanaka nezvakaipa
n-k-k7-03.goal: Gadzirisa kuverenga kwako ongororo yekafe sezvo chikamu chega chega chichisvika, cherekedza mutsara upi unotakura pfungwa yemunyori, wobva wanyora zano rinochengeta mativi ose maviri.
n-k-k7-03.material: Mudzidzi akanyora ongororo yepaIndaneti yekafe iri padyo neyunivhesiti. Shamwari yako inoda kudzidzira ipapo kwemaawa mana neMugovera. Uchaverenga ongororo chikamu nechikamu. (일부러 = zvakanangwa, 콘센트 = socket yemagetsi, -(으)ㄹ 만하다 = inofanira kuitwa)
n-k-k7-03.thinking.1: Kuona chikamu chipi chemutsara chinotakura pfungwa
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe, sarudza mhinduro inonzwika yakakodzera zvikuru, wobva wafambira mberi.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa chikamu chawaverenga kusvika zvino chete.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.1: Muchikamu chega chega, tarisa mutsara upi munyori anoratidzika kuda zvikuru.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Munyori angaudza shamwari inoda nzvimbo yekudzidzira chii zvikuru?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kusvika zvino pane kurumbidza chete, saka kuikurudzira kunonzwisisika. Muverengi ane hanya angamirira zvakawanda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Munyori anoti mimhanzi 조용해서, zvinoreva kunyarara.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Enda ipapo kana uchida vanhu vazhinji chete.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Pamwe enda, asi tarisa zvakadzama kutanga.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino munyori angaudza shamwari inoda kudzidzira ipapo masikati ose chii?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Chikamu chedambudziko chinotaura nezvekugara kwenguva refu: masocket mashoma, zvigaro zvakaoma. Kurumbidza kuchiri kwechokwadi, asi zano rinoenderana nenguva yaunogara.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Enda ipapo; ndiyo nzvimbo yakanakisisa yekudzidza kwenguva refu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mushure me하지만 munyori anotumidza matambudziko anokosha pakugara kwenguva refu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Munyori achiri kurumbidza nzvimbo iyi; kunyunyuta kuri pakugara kwenguva refu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Tsvaga imwe nzvimbo yekudzidza kwenguva refu; iyi iri nani pakugara kwenguva pfupi.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Enda ipapo kuti udzidze kwenguva refu, asi uuye nechaja chako.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ongororo inoti kugara kwenguva refu kunonetsa; chaja hachigadziriri zvigaro.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mutsara upi unotsanangura ongororo yose nenzira yakarurama zvikuru?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Mugumo unodzokorora kurumbidza asi unokubatanidza nemamiriro: awa rimwe kana maviri. Chidimbu chakarurama chinochengeta kurumbidza nemuganhu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kafe ine pfungwa huru yematambudziko ayo, kurumbidza kwatauriwa chete pakupfuura.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mutsara wekupedzisira unoti inofanira kushanyirwa kuverenga kwenguva pfupi, saka kurumbidza hakusi chidimbu chiri padivi.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kafe yakanaka, inonyarara inofanira kushanyirwa kugara kwekuverenga kwenguva pfupi, kwete kwenguva refu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Chikamu chechipiri chinotumidza miganhu chaiyo yenguva refu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kafe inokodzera kugara kwemaawa mana kunyange zvigaro.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Munyori anoti kugara kwenguva refu kunonetsa, saka izvi zvinopesana neongororo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.reflect: Cherekedza kuti zano rako rakachinja sei. Mutsara uri mushure me하지만 ne그래도 kazhinji unoratidza zvinodiwa nemunyori kuti uchengete, uye chidimbu chakarurama chinofanira kuchengeta kurumbidza kwekutanga nemuganhu wekupedzisira pamwe chete nemamiriro (kuti unogara kwenguva yakareba sei).
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yako inorongera kudzidza kwemaawa mana ipapo neMugovera. Muudze muchiKorea (nzira ipi neipi ine mutsa kana isina mutemo) zvaunokurudzira, uchishandisa zvinotaurwa neongororo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nechikamu cheongororo chinokosha zvikuru pamaawa mana.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera mutsara mumwe pfupi nezveyakanaka nzvimbo iyi.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zano rangu rinoenderana nenguva yaachagara here?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakachengeta divi rakanaka reongororo pamwe nedambudziko here?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.model.2: Pamaawa mana ndaizosarudza imwe nzvimbo: 의자 dzakaoma uye hapana 콘센트 inenge. Yakanaka kuverenga kwerimwe awa.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.2: ChiRungu chakasanganiswa chichiri kupfuura kutarisa kwepamusoro.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Inopa mhedziso yeongororo (kugara kwenguva pfupi chete) panzvimbo yekutumidza zvigaro.

n-k-k7-04.title: Chitoro chinoda kuziva chii?
n-k-k7-04.goal: Sarudza zvidimbu zveruzivo zvinodiwa nemeseji yekutanga yekunyunyuta, sarudza chikumbiro chisingagoni kunzwisiswa zvisina kururama, uye unyore meseji.
n-k-k7-04.material: Wakaodha jasi paIndaneti. Wakaodha saizi L asi jasi resaizi M rakasvika nezuro, uye hauridzipfeke. Uchatumira meseji yekutanga kusenta yevatengi yechitoro (고객센터) nekunyora. Mushandi haakuzivi uye anopindura mushure mekuverenga meseji yako chete.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Zvidimbu zveruzivo zvipi zvinofanira kuva mumeseji yako yekutanga kuti chitoro chigadzirise dambudziko pasina kunyorera kukubvunza? Sarudza zvose zvinoshanda.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti uri mushandi: zvokwadi zvipi zvaungafanira kubvunza nezvazvo usati wagona kuita chinhu?
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bvisa zvinyorwa nechitoro kare kana zvisingachinji zvavanoita zvinotevera.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.a: Kukumbira ruregerero pfupi nokuda kwekushungurudza mushandi
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Mutsa wakanaka, asi kukumbira ruregerero hakusi ruzivo rwunodiwa nechitoro kuti chiite.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Chitoro chatova nekero kubva paodha, uye nhamba yeodha inovabvumira kuiwana.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.d: Chinhu chipi chakasvika uye chine chii chisina kururama
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.e: Kuti unoda kuchinjanisa kana kudzorerwa mari
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.f: Kunonoka hakusi dambudziko pano; saizi isina kururama ndiro.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: Chitoro chinofanira kugona kuwana odha (nhamba yeodha), kunzwisisa zvakaipa (chinhu nesaizi), uye kuziva zvaunoda kuti zviitwe (kuchinjanisa kana kudzorerwa mari). Kukumbira ruregerero, kero yako nenguva yekuendesa hazvibatsiri kuita.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: Mutsara wechikumbiro upi unoudza chitoro zvekuita chaizvo?
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: Mutsara wega wega, bvunza kuti mushandi angashamisika nei mushure mekuuverenga.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Chikumbiro chakanaka chinopindura 'ita chii, kuti uwane chii?'
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvinogona kureva imwe saizi, rimwe ruvara kana jasi rakasiyana; chitoro hachigoni kuziva.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.explain: 'L 사이즈로 교환해 주세요' inotumidza chiito (교환) nemhedzisiro (saizi L). Zvimwe zvikumbiro zvinosiya chitoro chichifungidzira zvaunoda.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora meseji yako ku고객센터 muchiKorea (nzira ine mutsa kana yepamutemo, mitsara 2-4). Gadzira nhamba yeodha.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekukwazisa nechidimbu chimwe chechikonzero chekunyora.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.1: Wobva waisa zvokwadi zvitatu zvichitevedzana: odha ipi, chii chisina kururama, zvaunoda.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mushandi angaita here pameseji yangu pasina kunyorera kubvunza?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Pfupi, -요 ine mutsa; ichine zvokwadi zvitatu zvinodiwa.

n-k-k7-05.title: Vose? Kwete vose
n-k-k7-05.goal: Siyanisa 'kwete vose' ne 'hapana', sarudza humbowo hunoparadza chaizvo chirevo che 'vose', wobva wanyora chirevo chako pachako nemuenzaniso unopesana une mutsa.
n-k-k7-05.material: Pakuchinjana kwemitauro, muenzi anoti: "한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요." Iwe nevadzidzi vekirasi yako munoda kupindura nemutsa nechokwadi.
n-k-k7-05.prereq.0: Unoziva 모두, 다, 항상 ne -지 않다
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Pashamwari gumi dzechiKorea dzaunoziva, shanu dzinoda chikafu chinopisa uye shanu hadzidi. Chirevo chipi chakarurama?
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti mutsara wega wega unotaura nezvevangani vegumi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti mutsara unobvumirabe vashanu vanochida here.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.a: Izvo zvaizoreva kuti vose gumi havachidi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.c: Vashanu vacho vanochida, saka 'hapana munhu' ibhuku.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.d: Izvo zvaizoreva kuti vose gumi vanochida.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.explain: '모두 ...는 것은 아니에요' inoti 'vose' hazvisi chokwadi, asi inobvumirabe kuti vamwe vanochida. 'Hapana' raizova chirevo chakasimba kupfuura zvokwadi zvinotsigira.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Humbowo hupi humwe chete hunokwana kuratidza kuti '한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요' hairevi chokwadi?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: Chirevo chinotaura nezvevanhu vese veKorea uye nezvekuda. Bvunza kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inotaura chii pamusoro pekuda, uye nezvaani.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Edza sarudzo imwe neimwe: yaizoramba iri chokwadi here dai chirevo chiri chokwadi?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.a: Uyu i munhu anoda chikafu chine pepper, izvo zvinoenderana nechirevo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.b: Kune zvikafu zvakawanda zvine pepper, asi izvo hazvitauri chinhu nezvemunhu wese kuzvida.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.c: Kuda chikafu chine pepper asi kudya kashoma hakuputsi chirevo, nekuti chirevo chinotaura nezvekuda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.explain: Chirevo chevanhu vese chinogona kuputswa nemunhu mumwe asingaenderani. 민아 i muKorea asingadi chikafu chine pepper. Haudi kuratidza kuti vazhinji vanochivenga.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira mitsara miviri yako muKorea (kuremekedza). A anotaura chinhu chakasimba zvakanyanya pamusoro pegoka, achishandisa izwi sa 모두, 다 kana 항상 (semuenzaniso nezvevadzidzi, guta kana chikafu). B anopindura zvinoremekedza nemuenzaniso unopikisa chaiwo uye anoti hazvisi zvechokwadi kune vese.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza goka raunoziva zvakanaka, wobva wanyora mutsara waA une izwi rimwe re 'vese / nguva dzose'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kuna B, funga munhu chaiye mumwe kana chiitiko chisingaenderani, wobva wataura 'kwete vese' panzvimbo ye 'hapana'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Chirevo chaA chinotaura nezvevese chaizvo here, kuti muenzaniso mumwe uchiputse?
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yaB yakasimba chete sepamuenzaniso, kwete yakasimba kupfuura here?
